build_ecapa_tdnn_model: build an ECAPA_TDNN model using create_ecapa_tdnn_model with a base configuration
create_ecapa_tdnn_config: create an EcapaTDNNConfig dataclass with custom channels, kernel sizes, and dilations
build_ecapa_tdnn_builder: build an ECAPA_TDNNBuilder with config, device, and dtype to construct the model
register_ecapa_tdnn_arch: register a custom ECAPA_TDNN architecture using the ecapa_tdnn_arch decorator
create_ecapa_tdnn_base: create the base ECAPA_TDNN configuration with default channels, dilations, and embed_dim
